content.title: Graphic Reorganization | Character Poster to Carnival Lockup
content.summary: Character and angular plane modules first establish a fixed graphic family, and then complete a visual loop through high-density information reorganization, short-term neutral reset and final layout recycling; only as an evidence variant of the existing plane geometric reorganization template.

quick_start.input_format: Compact icon + stable character/color + density increasing module + isolated state pause + geometry lock
quick_start.recommended_input: On the original paper-cut plant archive page, the outline of the paper art curator and three moss-green ocher-yellow triangle seed labels are built on a cream fiber grid; two asymmetrical panels and plant line drawings are added, but no new graphic family is introduced, and the main identity continues; the same outline, label and grid are reconstructed into an asymmetrical rectangular flora cover, without adding a new motif
required_anchors: Establish one stable silhouette and one dominant graphic anchor.
Increase layout density using only established motifs and palette.
Use one brief low-information reset before the final build.
Resolve the established motif family into a held final lockup.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Character and angular plane modules first establish a fixed graphic family, and then complete a visual loop through high-density information reorganization, short-term neutral reset and final layout recycling; only as an evidence variant of the existing plane geometric reorganization template.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one stable subject silhouette and a small graphic motif family, progressively reorganize those elements into denser flat layouts, insert one brief low-information reset, then reconstruct a held final composition using only the established graphic family.

invariants.rule: Establish one stable silhouette and one dominant graphic anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unanchored collage has no identity.

invariants.rule: Increase layout density using only established motifs and palette.
Preserve subject identity through at least one major reorganization.
invariants.ablation_failure: Replacing the subject turns it into a montage.

invariants.rule: Use one brief low-information reset before the final build.
invariants.ablation_failure: Continuous density has no structural turn.

invariants.rule: Resolve the established motif family into a held final lockup.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unrelated end card discards prior history.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the exact angular panels and title copy
the exact gray reset and final poster
